data.name: Manfred
data.gender_notes: Manfred is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manfred is a Germanic name meaning 'man's strength'. It is derived from the Old High German 'man' meaning 'man' and 'frid' meaning 'peace'. In medieval literature, Manfred is the name of a legendary figure, the last emperor of the Holy Roman Empire. The name Manfred carries the meaning “Man's strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Manfred usually hope their child will grow to embody man's strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the strength and courage of God.
data.etymology: Manfred belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man's strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manfred total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
